rv.q: It's everything you love about musical theater dialed up to an 11.
The show promises a feast for the eyes the moment you step into the theater.

Pennette’s humorous writing pairs nicely with the playful music and lyrics of Julia Mattison and Noel Carey. While they have composed songs that fall short of enthralling on the show’s Broadway cast recording, they serve the show quite well, helping to advance the story — and continuing to fire joke...

cn.t: Critics praise this raucously entertaining Broadway hit as a laugh riot powered by stellar comic performances, particularly from its female leads, plus lavish production values and zingy one-liners that dial musical theater spectacle up to eleven.
